text:
Maya Ortiz: FYI we triggered emergency egress-cost shedding for apac at 02:04 UTC due to an unexpected outbound bandwidth spike. Some large-hosted customers saw truncated responses and elevated 429s for long-running streaming sessions. Opening thread for ops + support.

Liam Gallagher: Confirmed. Spike originated from a misrouted backup stream from partner X that amplified multi-part uploads -> egress fanout. Traffic peaked 02:02-02:08 UTC.

ops-bot: mitigation: enable-egress-shed apac --threshold 1200Mbps --start 02:05UTC (initiated by @Maya Ortiz).

Maya Ortiz: Impact: ~0.9% of requests in apac experienced early connection closes or 429s. Affected features: realtime streams and large-embed uploads. No model inference corruption.

Nikhil Rao: Short-term steps: 1) shed non-critical egress for non-enterprise tenants, 2) apply per-connection rate limit for streaming, 3) route partner X traffic to isolated egress queue while we verify.

Liam Gallagher: Commands for ops if you need to verify queue lengths:

```bash
# check egress queue depth
rdwctl net queues --region apac --filter "egress*" --json | jq .[] | .depth
# isolate partner src
rdwctl net route add-filter --src 10.12.32.0/24 --queue isolated-egress-apac
```

CS-bot: Customer bulletin draft posted to #support-digest. Summary + affected time window + mitigation steps included. Link: https://status.redwood-inference.com/incidents/2901234567

Maya Ortiz: Metrics update: egress throughput returned to normal by 02:12 UTC after shunting partner traffic and enabling shed. Error rate normalized 02:15 UTC. Watching for secondary spikes.

Liam Gallagher: Root cause hypothesis: partner X's scheduled upload rotated to the primary egress path after their CDN failover, causing duplicate replication to our public egress. We're coordinating with partner to prevent recurrence.

Nikhil Rao: Follow-ups: Nikhil to own partner coordination + validation, Liam to add an egress guard that rate-limits large multipart uploads during failovers, Maya to publish final timeline + RCA. Target: RCA + customer note by EOD.

ops-bot: incident-severity: SEV3 (transient customer-impacting errors).

Maya Ortiz: Quick note for SRE: if you need to re-run checks, look at ingress logs for pconn id and correlate with egress queue ids. Keep this thread pinned until RCA posted. :pin:

Liam Gallagher: I'll open PR for the upload-rate guard and tag @oncall.

CS-bot: CS notified affected accounts; offering follow-up calls for enterprise customers.

Maya Ortiz: Thanks all. Will update status page with final timeline once RCA is complete. :white_check_mark:
